yes.yes: Was there something else you wanted to ask?

no.yes: You are on your feet, swordsman. After that night, that is no small thing.
no.no: You can stand again. Then the time I won for you that night was not wasted.

responses.text: Was it you who carried me out?
I want to understand what happened.
Tell me about the Brand and those who come at night.
Will you help me?
Where should I look for this evil now?
I found something among the remains.
Who are you?
It is time for me to go.
About the strange stone and the changes.
That is enough for now. I will speak to you again.

//: Approved Skull Knight script 2026-10-22; ordinary close is not farewell.

dynamic_line.yes: I found an opening and carried you through before it closed. But carrying a body out of a place of sacrifice does not free it from the sacrifice itself.

no.yes: Yes. You were among those who were not meant to leave that ceremony alive. I carried you out. The people where you woke did the rest.
no.no: I carried you somewhere I could leave you safely. We did not reach the woodland forge.

responses.text: Because of this mark?
Griffith. What became of him?

dynamic_line: Was saving your life not help enough?

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

yes.yes: Godot and Rickert. You have already spoken with both of them. They sheltered you when I brought you here.
yes.no: You know Godot. The young craftsman at his forge is Rickert; you have yet to meet him yourself.

dynamic_line.no: Godot is a smith. Rickert works beside him on crossbows and mechanisms. You will have to meet them for yourself.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: You saw the boundary where greatness is bought with other lives. Those who rose above the crowd accepted that harvest. Those feasting beneath the throne merely did what they had been permitted.

responses.text: Were those creatures once human?
And those who stood above them?
Why is this happening among our cities?
Can things be put back as they were?
What became of Griffith?
Can the one who presided over this do it again?
I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: Many were. They rejected their nature when an earthly existence was no longer enough. Their old failings and desires remained. Sometimes those human habits make the monsters recognizable. And vulnerable.

responses.text: Can they be destroyed?
I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: Their altered flesh can be destroyed. Do not mistake their bodies for true immortality. Nor should you look for human mercy where the abyss rules.

responses.text: How do I fight them with ordinary weapons?
I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: Wait before you step forward. Study how the enemy moves, what it protects and when it must pause for breath. Know where you will retreat. Blind fury is no substitute for a way back.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: The God Hand. Do not confuse them with the servants admitted to the feast. Killing an ordinary apostle does not bring their overthrow a step closer.

responses.text: Then resistance is pointless?
I defeated his reflection. How could he be there again?
I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: If I thought your struggle useless, I would not have carried you out of that hell.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: This land had already been wounded by its own end of the world. Another darkness seeps through the open wounds. The boundary has thinned, making your home accessible to hungrier predators.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: The past cannot be restored, even if every passage is sealed. But you can keep the next traveler from meeting the same fate.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: He took the throne offered to him. Your memories of the man cannot explain the abyss into which he was reborn.

responses.text: I do not care what he became. I will reach his throat.
I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: Then first learn to live until the next dawn. Otherwise your oath of vengeance will be no more than the last words of a man dying in the night.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: Do not expect what you witnessed to be the last expression of that will. Your concern now is to endure the threat already following you.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: You dispersed a reflection. It could take his shape and carry some of his power, but it was not the being you seek.

responses.text: Then that fight meant nothing?
How can I distinguish a reflection from the original?
Will there be more reflections?
I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: The shape that stood before you will threaten no one else. That matters. But do not credit your victory with something it did not accomplish.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: A face is not enough. Consider where it came from, what holds it here and what it leaves behind. A vanished shadow is not proof of an original death.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: While the boundaries between worlds remain broken, I would not call that encounter the last.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: The Brand remains a mark of sacrifice. Beings beyond the boundary can discern it where a human eye sees nothing. Night makes their journey to you easier.

responses.text: Does it warn me of danger?
Will they come every night?
What should I do before dark?
How can I protect my refuge?
Will closing a breach remove the Brand?
I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: Pain and blood may come before a creature appears, especially a powerful one. Heed that warning, but do not expect it to name your enemy or show a safe road. The Brand is no friend to you. It simply is.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: Not every night is the same. Sometimes you will hear only footsteps beyond a wall. Sometimes you will have to abandon your shelter and run. Silence does not mean they have forgotten you.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: Find a place you can leave. Do not corner yourself for the imagined safety of walls. Prepare light, dressings and weapons. Keep what you need close: there will be no time to pack when you must flee.

responses.text: Will a locked door help?
Will they disappear in the morning?
I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: Against some of them, yes. But an ordinary wall cannot keep out everything that comes from the darkness. Some creatures need no door.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: Dawn may end the pursuit itself. It does not promise to destroy those that already reached you. Look at what remains outside before opening the door.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line.yes: You have already begun preparing. Wise. But do not mistake that sign for a fortress wall. It will not destroy a creature already beside you; it hinders the way here.
dynamic_line.no: There are signs that hinder their approach. I will leave you the instructions. But a sign cannot replace shelter: choose somewhere you can defend and leave.

responses.text: Then I can sleep peacefully?
Tell me how to arrange it.
I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: More peacefully. Not carelessly. Even a protected place must have an exit. Never make the sign your last hope.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: Arrange eight stones and four bones into a sign on clear ground. Keep it close to your sleeping place. Its protection stays on the same level; it will not drive away creatures already here.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: No. You will close one road into this world, and that matters to those who live nearby. The mark on your body belongs to another bond. Closing a breach does not break it.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line.yes: First let your wounds close. Speak with the craftsmen, gather what you need and prepare for night. The road will not disappear while you learn to walk it without falling at the first step.

no.yes: The trail leads to the forest hollow. The direction is already in your records. Prepare before following it; I will not choose your next step for you.
Victory left you more than a dead enemy. Examine what remains in its lair. You may find why it came to these lands.
You have found the trail of a passage. Now deal with the wound itself. A fallen keeper does not always mean the road behind it has closed.
The roads you learned are already marked. Follow an unfinished trail when you are ready. You need not take on every enemy at once.
no.no: You have exhausted the trails you had. Revisit the evidence and speak with those you trust. The next road remains to be discovered; I will not point you toward something I do not know.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: Judeau saw other people even when everything around him was turning them into prey.

responses.text: I want him remembered.
It was not enough.
I wanted to ask about someone else who died.

dynamic_line: Sometimes a man knows he cannot hold the enemy. Still he stands between it and those who can escape.

responses.text: I should have been beside him.
You call that victory?
I wanted to ask about someone else who died.

dynamic_line: A victim has a life that cannot fit inside the word victim. Desires, failings, arguments. Do not give the monsters that part of him as well.

responses.text: He was no hero.
We often disagreed.
I wanted to ask about someone else who died.

dynamic_line: Such hopes are easily lost behind banners and the names of commanders. To him that future mattered no less than another man's dream of a kingdom.

responses.text: What should I do with the keepsake?
That makes it harder.
I wanted to ask about someone else who died.

dynamic_line: Tell me what you found.

responses.text: I found judeau's traces. I remember him.

dynamic_line: Not enough to stop all that happened. But you do not know how much time his act gave someone else.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: Then preserve more than how he died. Preserve who he was.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: I call it an act that cannot be measured only by who remained standing.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: You may carry that thought all your life. It cannot put you beside him that night. Decide whom you will stand beside now.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: Grief does not require that you agreed on everything in life.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: They did not need to become heroes to deserve their lives.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: Yes. You see not only a death but everything that can never follow it.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: Keep it, give it to someone who knew him, or leave it in a worthy place. Memory does not demand you always carry its weight.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: One who has long walked against them.

responses.text: That is no name.
Why did you save me?
Why did you not save the others?
Were you once human too?
Can fate be changed?
Why will you not stay?

dynamic_line: No. But for now it tells you more than a name.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: I had the chance to intervene. I took it.

responses.text: And you want nothing in return?
I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: I did not carry you out of one bargain to immediately bind you to another.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: Because I could not.

responses.text: But you knew what was happening.
I cannot accept that.
I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: Knowing of a disaster and having the power to stop it are not the same.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: I am not asking you to accept it. But do not base your next step on the belief that someone could have fixed everything with a single blow.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: Enough humanity remains in me to remember what I fight against.

responses.text: And the rest?
I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: Not every story needs to be told at another man's threshold.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: You are alive and asking that question. Begin there.

responses.text: Then everything depends on my choice?
I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: No. But your choice still belongs to you. Do not give it away merely because you cannot rule everything else.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: I have my own road. Our enemies will not wait for you to recover.

responses.text: Will we meet again?
I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line: Perhaps. But do not build your life around waiting for me.

responses.text: I wanted to ask about something else.

dynamic_line.no: Then know this: I will continue my journey. If you still have questions, ask them now. Do not expect me to return to this threshold.

responses.text: Wait. I have more questions.
Remind me of the essentials.
I understand. Farewell.

dynamic_line.yes: Prepare for night. Ask the craftsmen for what you lack. Then follow a trail you know. Do not try to settle your whole war in a single battle.
dynamic_line.no: Recover before another fight. Prepare what you need, and follow a trail you already know.

responses.text: I still have questions.
Farewell.

dynamic_line.yes: Then preserve the life with which you intend to continue.
dynamic_line.no: Live on. What kind of life it will be is yours to decide.

responses.text: Watch the rider leave.

dynamic_line: 'The Eclipse has not claimed you yet. I will cut a way out. Stay close.' Beyond his shoulder, the darkness recoils from his blade.

responses.text: What is happening?
Get me out of here.

dynamic_line: 'Survive first. Answers can wait.' He raises his sword, and a path opens through the dark.

responses.text: Follow the Skull Knight.

dynamic_line: 'You broke the manifestation that held this ceremony together. Do not mistake that for killing one of the God Hand. The wound is closing: come with me, now.'

responses.text: Follow the Skull Knight out of the Eclipse.
